Game Overview

In Arrow, the core idea is straightforward: step into the world of Arrow, where your precision and quick reflexes as an archer are put to the test. Aim for colorful, elusive fruits with limited arrows, honing your timing and skill for extra rewards in a visually vibrant setting. Can you hit the target every time?
